summary.text: Rob Wagner is a Democratic state senator from Oregon Senate District 19 who has served since January 2018, was elected Senate president ahead of the 2023 session, and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.

paragraphs.text: Rob Wagner was born in California in 1973 and grew up in Lake Oswego, Oregon.
He earned a bachelor's degree in political science from Portland State University in 1997 and a master's in public policy from George Washington University in 2001.

Wagner worked as a legislative aide in the Oregon House, as director of political and legislative affairs for the American Federation of Teachers, and as associate vice president of college advancement for Portland Community College.
Wagner won election unopposed to the Lake Oswego School Board in May 2017.
The Washington, Clackamas and Multnomah county boards of commissioners appointed him to the Senate in 2018 to replace Richard Devlin, and he resigned from the school board in 2020.
He served as Senate majority leader from 2020 to 2023, and was elected Senate president ahead of the 2023 session, replacing Peter Courtney.
In the 2023-2024 session, he was assigned to the Senate Education Committee and the Joint Transportation Committee.
